title: Smart Data Models - Mobility Data Specification (MDS) - Vehicle
description: A vehicle (device) registered by a mobility provider in MDS: identity, vehicle type, propulsion and capabilities. (MDS 2.1.0, data-types.md section 'Vehicles'; field names kept verbatim; MDS timestamps are integer milliseconds since the Unix epoch.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:Vehicle:<device_id>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Vehicle'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

device_id.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/openmobilityfoundation/mobility-data-specification/blob/2.1.0/data-types.md#vehicles/device_id'. A unique device ID in UUID format, should match this device in Provider.

provider_id.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/openmobilityfoundation/mobility-data-specification/blob/2.1.0/data-types.md#vehicles/provider_id'. A UUID for the Provider, unique within MDS. See MDS provider list.

data_provider_id.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/openmobilityfoundation/mobility-data-specification/blob/2.1.0/data-types.md#vehicles/data_provider_id'. If different than 'provider_id', a UUID for the data solution provider managing the data feed in this endpoint. See MDS provider list which includes both service operators and data solution providers.

vehicle_id.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/openmobilityfoundation/mobility-data-specification/blob/2.1.0/data-types.md#vehicles/vehicle_id'. A unique vehicle identifier (visible code, license plate, etc), visible on the vehicle itself.

vehicle_attributes.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/openmobilityfoundation/mobility-data-specification/blob/2.1.0/data-types.md#vehicles/vehicle_attributes'. Mode Specific. Vehicle attributes given as mode-specific unordered key-value pairs.

propulsion_types.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/openmobilityfoundation/mobility-data-specification/blob/2.1.0/data-types.md#vehicles/propulsion_types'. Array of propulsion types; allows multiple values.

accessibility_attributes.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/openmobilityfoundation/mobility-data-specification/blob/2.1.0/data-types.md#vehicles/accessibility_attributes'. Mode Specific. Accessibility attributes given as an array of enumerated values. List of any accessibility attributes available on the vehicle. (Required if Available.)

battery_capacity.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/openmobilityfoundation/mobility-data-specification/blob/2.1.0/data-types.md#vehicles/battery_capacity'. Capacity of battery expressed as milliamp hours (mAh) (Required if Available.) Units:'mAh'.

fuel_capacity.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/openmobilityfoundation/mobility-data-specification/blob/2.1.0/data-types.md#vehicles/fuel_capacity'. Capacity of fuel tank (liquid, solid, gaseous) expressed in liters. (Required if Available.) Units:'liters'.

maximum_speed.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/openmobilityfoundation/mobility-data-specification/blob/2.1.0/data-types.md#vehicles/maximum_speed'. Maximum speed (kph) possible with vehicle under normal, flat incline, smooth surface conditions. Applicable if the device has a built-in or intelligent speed limiter/governor. (Required if Available.) Units:'km/h'.

hardware_model.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/openmobilityfoundation/mobility-data-specification/blob/2.1.0/data-types.md#vehicles/hardware_model'. Number, identifier, or description of the main device hardware model. Can apply to any mode. (Required if Available.)

commissioned.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/openmobilityfoundation/mobility-data-specification/blob/2.1.0/data-types.md#vehicles/commissioned'. Date/time the vehicle first starts providing service in the jurisdiction. Required if asked for by public agency. (Conditionally Required.) Units:'milliseconds since the Unix epoch (MDS Timestamp)'.

decommissioned.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/openmobilityfoundation/mobility-data-specification/blob/2.1.0/data-types.md#vehicles/decommissioned'. Date/time the vehicle stops providing service in the jurisdiction and is decommissioned. Required when the vehicle is retired from operations. (Conditionally Required.) Units:'milliseconds since the Unix epoch (MDS Timestamp)'.
